reason: B is the better proposal because a composition-preserving grain-structure intervention is more likely to retain the composition-sensitive magnetostructural caloric transition, while SiC addition could promote brittleness and alter transition chemistry; A’s evidence only establishes strengthening in a dissimilar FCC alloy and even reports reduced plasticity. B remains incomplete because it gives no explicit annealing or operating boundaries and extrapolates mechanisms from ductile low-SFE CrCoNi, but it is more physically plausible and directly testable.
